rules.name: Follow-Up Attack
rules.description: Once per turn, if Michonne wins a melee she may move into base contact with another standing enemy within her Kill Zone. Resolve this new melee immediately, even if one or more combatants has already fought.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Masked Sent Mike and Terry fill one hand slot together. May not be placed in the pack. The Mike model must stay within 1" of Michonne. He is treated as a Walker by enemies. If attacked, he may only defend, and is removed when damaged. Discard Mike to ignore all damage from a single attack.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Masked Sent Mike and Terry fill one hand slot together. May not be placed in the pack. The Terry model must stay within 1" of Michonne. He is treated as a Walker by enemies. If attacked, he may only defend, and is removed when damaged. Discard Terry to ignore all damage from a single attack.

rules.name: Responsibility
rules.description: If Duane or Carl Grimes is included in the same group, Morgan will not Panic as long as either of them is alive.

rules.name: Bodyguard
rules.description: If Lori is in the same group and is targetted by a ranged attack whilst within Shane's Kill Zone, Shane may take the attack on her behalf. Shane becomes the new target, even if he was not initially within range or line of sight.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Survival of the Fittest
rules.description: Once per game, this model and every Survivor in its group with a base value of 40 points or more may perform one extra action during their activation. This bonus lasts for only a single action phase - if the extra action is not used, it is wasted.

rules.name: Mean Streak
rules.description: Whenever Shane would be engaged by a Walker in the Kill Zone stage of the Event phase, he may nominate one friendly model within the Walker's Kill Zone for the Walker to engage instead.

rules.name: Mean Streak
rules.description: Whenever Andy would be engaged by a Walker in the Kill Zone stage of the Event phase, he may nominate one friendly model also within the Walker's Kill Zone for the Walker to engage instead.

rules.name: Adaptable
rules.description: Clementine does not have a set character type - she must choose one at the start of each game. In addition, she may choose one of her characteristics - Melee, Shoot, or Defense - and add 1 Red to it for the duration of the game.

rules.name: Father Figure
rules.description: Whilst Clementine is in Lee's Kill Zone, she will not Panic.

rules.name: Fiercely Protective
rules.description: If one or more friendly Survivors within 8" of Lee take damage in a turn, Lee ads 1 Red to his melee attack rolls for the rest of the turn. If the Survivor that takes damage is  Clementine, Lee adds 1 White instead.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Resourceful
rules.description: Once per turn, one friendly Survivor within 8" of Lee may reroll a single die of any type.

infoLinks.name: Leader Ability: Be More Afraid of Me...

rules.name: Goggles Down...
rules.description: Juanita gains one bonus Red to her melee attack rolls for every enemy in the same combat after the first, to a maximum bonus of 3Red.

rules.name: A Little Loopy
rules.description:
At the start of each of her activations, roll 1Blue to see which special rule applies to Juanita this turn:

1Hit: Juanita adds 2" to her Run distance.
2Hits: One friendly model within 3" of Juanita that is yet to activate gains 1 bonus Action.
3Hits: Juanita gains 1 bonus Action.

rules.name: Psychotic
rules.description: At the start of his activation, after Panic rolls, if there is an enemy Survivor in Thomas`Kill Zone who is not currently at full health, his first Action must be to Move into contact with them, if possible.

rules.name: Stab!
rules.description: Thomas may reroll any of his melee attack dice when using a weapon with the "Sharp" keyword.

rules.name: The Muscle
rules.description: If Dexter chosses to attack and is on the winning side in melee, his side inflicts 1 extra point of damage against the enemy.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Top Dog
rules.description:
Each turn, Dexter may roll 1 White die.
He may distribute that many bonus Actions freely between Andrew, Axel, and Thomas, if they are in his group and have not yet activated (max 1 each ).

rules.name: Unstable
rules.description:
At the start of each of Carol`s activations, before Panic is rolled, roll 1 Blue die.
This is how many Actions Carol may take this turn.

rules.name: Vulnerable
rules.description: If Carol is in the Kill Zone of a friendly model from the same Faction, that model will not Panic.

rules.name: Irrational Outbursts
rules.description:
At the end of each of Carol`s activations, roll a black die.
On a blank she creates NOISE.

rules.name: Exper Shot
rules.description: When Carlos performs a ranged attack, he may force the target to discard a Cover die of their choice.

rules.name: Raging!
rules.description: Tyreese adds an extra 1 to the Threat Level whenever he fights un melee. While the Threat Level is High, he adds one red die to his melee attack rolls.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: Tyreese recieves one bonus red die to his melee attack or defense rolls for every enemy in the same combat after the first ( so if fighting 4 enemies, he would recieve three red dice.

rules.name: Blind Spot
rules.description: Carl ignores one ! that he rolls in every Shoot Action.

rules.name: Rebellious
rules.description: If Carl starts his activation more than 10" away from his Group`s Leader, roll a Black die. On a shield, he gains an extra Action.

rules.name: Reckless
rules.description:
At the start of his activation, if the closest enemy is a Survivor, Carl must Shoot it if possible. If not, and it is within 8", he must move into contact with it, Running if necessary.
He may spend any remaining Actions as normal.
Carl may not Hold his Nerve, be may re-roll the Panic die.

rules.name: Vengeful
rules.description: Carl adds 1 Red die to all attack rolls against Saviors.

rules.name: Blind Loyalty
rules.description: Scott is desperate to prove his worth. If Scott has not yet been activated when you activate his group Leader, they may sacrifice one of their Actions to give Scott an order. If they do this, Scott must be the next model in the group to activate. He will be immune to panic for the turn, and he may perform 3 Actions. He may perform the same Action up to twice, but may not Run twice.

rules.name: Arena Fighter
rules.description: When in melee with a single enemy Survivor, Michonne may re-roll any of her melee dice.

rules.name: Follow-Up Attack
rules.description: Once per turn, if Michonne wins a melee she may move into base contact with another standing enemy within her Kill Zone. Resolve this new melee immediately, even if one or more combatants has already fought.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Single-Minded
rules.description: At the start of each game, choose one enemy Survivor or one supply counter as Michonne's target. Michonne must always move towards her target if possible and if she reaches it must attack it in melee / Search it. While that survivor is alive / counter is not in Michonne's group's possession, Michonne's group will never Panic and can re-roll blanks in melee.

rules.name: Prey on the Weak
rules.description: Jud ignores the Just a Kid special rule.

rules.name: Co-ordinated Ambush
rules.description:
While Andy and Craig are both in Jud's group and alive, all three of them have Medium nerve. In addition, any one of them may spend an Action to immediately take an Action with one of the other two. 

This can be done even if the other model is already activated, and will not mark them as such if they are not.

rules.name: Duplicitous
rules.description: When Spencer is targeted by a ranged attack, roll 1Black. On a Shield, choose a friendly model in his Kill Zone to take the attack on his behalf, even if it was not in range or line of sight.

rules.name: Look After Number One
rules.description: When a friendly model in Spencer's Kill Zone is wounded by an enemy attack, Spencer may immediately move up to 2", treated as an out-of-sequence Sneak. This move may not be used to engage an enemy. If Spencer is engaged, ignore this rule.

rules.name: Nimble
rules.description: At the start of a combat, Andrew may roll a black die. On a shield, he moves out of base contact and at least 1" away from all current enemies, by the shortest route possible (moving through models if necessary).
